description_en: Retrieves the list of all supported parser types based on the specified file type (file name extension)
description_zh: 根据输入的文件类型（文件扩展名），获取所有支持的解析器类型列表
kebab_example: aliyun bailian get-available-parser-types --workspace-id llm-3shx2gu255oqxxxx --file-type pdf --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAvailableParserTypes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the file belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
